title: Canonical biduality reduces to the heart
statement: Let C be a symmetric monoidal closed Grothendieck abelian category with additive tensor and functorial flat resolutions, and use its native monoidal derived category and Koszul braiding. Let W be any derived object, and let Q be an isomorphism-invariant property of objects of C. If the canonical map M[0] -> RHom(RHom(M[0],W),W) is invertible for every M with Q(M), then it is invertible for every bounded complex K whose homology objects have Q. No geometric property of W or constructibility assumption is imposed.

proof.text: The shift of the tensor unit is invertible, with inverse the opposite shift, by shiftTensorShiftIso and the zero-shift isomorphism. Identify K[n] with K tensor 1[n]. The proved isIso_toIhomIhom_tensor_iff makes canonical biduality invariant under shift.

Let P(K) assert invertibility at every shift. Naturality of toIhomIhomNatTrans gives isomorphism invariance; shift addition gives shift stability. P contains zero since internal Hom of zero into W is zero.

Apply exists_distinguished_ihom_pre twice to a distinguished triangle. At each shift the two outer P hypotheses give the two outer isomorphisms and the adjacent shifts needed by isIso_app_obj₂_of_distTriang. This proved triangulated five lemma gives extension closure, so P is triangulated.

Apply the existing proved DerivedCategory.prop_of_bounded to P, Q, the heart hypothesis with shift invariance, and the boundedness and homology hypotheses on K. Transport the assertion at shift zero along shiftFunctorZero.

lean.statement:
theorem biduality_of_bounded_heart (W : DerivedCategory C)
    (Q : ObjectProperty C) [Q.IsClosedUnderIsomorphisms]
    (hQ : ∀ (M : C), Q M →
      IsIso (toIhomIhom W ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor C 0).obj M)))
    (K : DerivedCategory C) (hb : DerivedCategory.TStructure.t.bounded K)
    (hc : ∀ n, Q ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor C n).obj K)) :
    IsIso (toIhomIhom W K)
